_meta.description: Curated author attributions for whole-volume / anthology corpus keys (ocr.*, cogPG.*) that build_registry.py's ingested-works pass would otherwise file under a pseudo-author minted from the slug prefix (anon-ocr, anon-cogPG). Each work entry names the real author slug (reusing the canon author entry when one exists), a display title, and the two evidence sources used to verify the attribution: (1) the volume's own served rows in data/corpus/<key>.jsonl (incipits, section heads, and token shares measured by cumulative position), and (2) the standard bibliography for the volume (the Patrologia Graeca per-volume table; the edition's own title for Walz / Mansi / Bussemaker-Daremberg). Multi-author volumes are attributed to the dominant author only when that author holds >=90% of the served tokens; otherwise a collective label naming the actual authors is used. Per-treatise dissolution of the collective volumes is future work.

policy.dominant_author: attribute to an author holding >=90% of served tokens (share documented)
policy.collective: no author reaches 90%: mint a name-only collective label naming the actual authors
policy.qids: every real-person author entry carries a Wikidata QID verified against wikidata.org (dates/description); collective labels and editions without a Wikidata item stay name-only
